create_MJCFBaseBulletEnv_subclass: create a subclass of MJCFBaseBulletEnv to define a custom Bullet physics Gym environment with a robot
reset_MJCFBaseBulletEnv_simulation: reset the MJCFBaseBulletEnv simulation to initialize the physics client and restart the episode
render_MJCFBaseBulletEnv_rgb_array: render the MJCFBaseBulletEnv as an RGB array by calling render with mode set to rgb_array
configure_MJCFBaseBulletEnv_robot_args: configure the MJCFBaseBulletEnv robot arguments by passing a dictionary of args to the configure method
move_Camera_look_at: move the Camera to look at a target position by calling move_and_look_at with coordinates
